parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set chassis fpc 2 pic 0 e1 0 channel-set.template: set chassis fpc [parameter1] pic [parameter2] e1 [parameter3] channel-set [parameter4] timeslot-list [parameter5]
set chassis fpc 2 pic 0 e1 0 channel-set.command: set chassis fpc 2 pic 0 e1 0 channel-set 1 timeslot-list 1-31
set chassis fpc 2 pic 0 e1 0 channel-set.explanation: 配置E1接口的通道集和时隙列表。

parameters.name: timeslot-list
parameters.explanation: 时隙列表，指定使用的时隙范围。

set chassis fpc 2 pic 0 e1 0 loopback-ty.template: set chassis fpc [parameter1] pic [parameter2] e1 [parameter3] loopback-type [parameter4]
set chassis fpc 2 pic 0 e1 0 loopback-ty.command: set chassis fpc 2 pic 0 e1 0 loopback-type remote
set chassis fpc 2 pic 0 e1 0 loopback-ty.explanation: 配置E1接口的环回类型为远程环回。

parameters.name: loopback-type
parameters.explanation: 环回类型，例如remote表示远程环回。

deactivate chassis fpc 2 pic 0 e1 0 loop.template: deactivate chassis fpc [parameter1] pic [parameter2] e1 [parameter3] loopback-type [parameter4]
deactivate chassis fpc 2 pic 0 e1 0 loop.command: deactivate chassis fpc 2 pic 0 e1 0 loopback-type remote
deactivate chassis fpc 2 pic 0 e1 0 loop.explanation: 取消E1接口的远程环回配置。

parameters.name: loopback-type
parameters.explanation: 环回类型，例如remote表示远程环回。
